components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only filled, colored button. Soft-green fill with white text; carries every primary action. Mobile-first 44px touch target collapsing to 32px desktop.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 6px; background: #218768; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; font: 500 14px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 0; height: 32px; } } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1c6c55; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(33,135,104,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Transparent field, hairline border, 32px tall. Border + green ring on focus; red on error.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; font: 400 16px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { font-size: 14px; } } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #218768; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(33,135,104,0.5); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #dc2626; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(220,38,38,0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge (doc-neutral)
components.description: Pill status chip with a FIXED semantic palette — never recolored by data-dfe-theme. Status is a universal vocabulary the user must recognize across every doc type.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 600 12px/1 "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-pending { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; } .ds-status-authorized { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-status-rejected { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; } .ds-status-failed { background: #fecaca; color: #991b1b; } .ds-status-cancelled { background: #f1f5f9; color: #64748b; }

narrative.overview: The interface is the competent colleague who has already done the bureaucratic work for you. It is calm, fast, and invisible — it disappears into the task of issuing and tracking a tax document. The voice is sharp efficiency: plain-language, no fiscal jargon performance, zero wasted motion. Every screen earns its density; nothing is decorative. This system explicitly rejects the bureaucratic government portal, the generic SaaS cream/beige monoculture, playful/gamified consumer aesthetics, and dense enterprise tools with no visual hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: One quiet green brand, four document accents — color signals which document type you're in.
Compact, consistent controls (32px desktop / 44px touch on mobile) that respect expert density without clutter.
Real-time status is always legible — you never wonder 'did it go through?'.
Flat surfaces at rest; depth appears only as a response to state.
Mobile-first from 375px; the same vocabulary across every screen and breakpoint.

rules.name: The One Accent Per Surface Rule
rules.body: The core UI is green. A non-green accent appears only inside a data-dfe-theme scope (NFC-e/CT-e/MDF-e) — never as free decoration on a green screen.

rules.name: The Calm Baseline Rule
rules.body: Page and card backgrounds stay near-white (#ffffff / #f8fafc). Depth comes from hairline borders and state shadows, never from a colored wash.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No display or serif face in UI labels, buttons, or data. Weight and size carry hierarchy; a second font is noise.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on hover, elevation, or focus — never as ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep the core UI green; let NFC-e/CT-e/MDF-e accents appear only inside their data-dfe-theme scope.
Do reuse the control vocabulary everywhere (32px / 44px height, 14px radius); consistency is the product's virtue.
Do route all destructive text through --color-danger (#dc2626, red-600) so the AA floor can't drift to red-500.
Do show skeleton loaders (not center spinners) for initial loads, and a subtle dim for background refetches.
Do debounce every input that triggers an API call (300ms default).
Do treat modals as a last resort — exhaust inline and progressive disclosure first. When a modal is right, use the shared Modal (sticky chrome, focus-trap, mobile-safe).
donts: Don't build a bureaucratic government portal: dated, low-contrast, no hierarchy, anxiety-inducing.
Don't fall into the generic SaaS cream/beige monoculture — keep the canvas near-white and the accent intentional.
Don't use playful / gamified consumer aesthetics that undercut fiscal seriousness.
Don't ship a dense enterprise tool with no visual hierarchy or breathing room.
Don't add a second font family for display or labels; weight and size carry hierarchy.
Don't put a colored wash behind resting surfaces — depth comes from hairlines and state shadows, not fills.
Don't use a border-left/right stripe wider than 1px as a colored accent on cards or list rows.
Don't make inactive states full-saturation; reserve the green (and per-type accents) for primary actions, current selection, and state indicators.
Don't recolor status badges by data-dfe-theme — status is a fixed, universal vocabulary (green/red/amber/gray/blue), not a per-type accent.
Don't use red-500 (#ef4444) for resting destructive text; it fails AA. Use text-danger (red-600).
